{{Top|leg}}
'''Brun''' was a [[shakwulf]] kept by a [[Unidentified Republic soldier (Falang Minor)|farmer]] on [[Okator VIII]] around [[23,900 BBY]] to herd [[Whellay/Legends|whellays]]. Brun was killed when [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] raiders attacked Okator VIII toward the end of the [[Tionese War]].
